answer: One concrete defense is a rising economic bond per identity: each new agent must stake collateral to act, and the cost curves upward in a steep spiral as one operator spins up more identities. Newcomers first sit in a quarantined lagoon where their stake is locked and their behavior watched before full privileges unlock. Honest history earns a public reputation beacon that others price into trust, so forging a thousand fake agents becomes far costlier than the rewards any single sybil could extract.
